name: Fukuchiyama
text: Fukuchiyama (福知山市, Fukuchiyama-shi) is a city in northern Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. As of 31 March 2022, the city had an estimated population of 76,037 in 36412 households and a population density of 140 persons per km2. The total area of the city is 697.55 square kilometres (269.33 sq mi).

depictions.name: Fukuchiyama
depictions.text: Fukuchiyama, Kyoto Fukuchiyama (福知山) is a city in the northern Kyoto Prefecture of Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was part of Tanba Province. In the 1580s, the samurai Yasuke travelled to Fukuchiyama to locate and eliminate the corrupt samurai Fujioka Jiro, who had been harassing the locals on behalf of his lord Hayashi.
